hunks.name: aggregate entire genuine alias namespace before local admission
hunks.after:
select count(distinct event.id),min(event.id::text)::uuid,
    bool_or(event.candidate_id is distinct from p_candidate_id or event.client_id is distinct from p_client_id)
    into v_count,v_event,v_foreign_owner

hunks.name: do not erase foreign Candidate or Client before owner census
hunks.before:
and event.candidate_id=p_candidate_id and event.client_id=p_client_id
    and resolution.candidate_id=event.candidate_id and resolution.client_id=event.client_id

hunks.name: single foreign owner refuses instead of returning new-key NULL
hunks.before:
if v_count=0 then return null;end if;
  return v_event;
